Strength In Elegance
Cooler Master presents the GX Ill Gold featuring exceptional efficiency, low noise output, and superb reliability.
Innovative, Streamlined Design
The innovative design streamlines the overall aesthetic of the unit and greatly improves airflow.
ATX 3.1 Support & a Durable 90-degree 12V-2x6 Cable
Includes ATX 3.1 support and a 90-degree 12V-2X6 PCle 5.1 connector featuring higher electrical durability, improved safety, and capable of bringing up to 600W to your GPU.*All performance stats confirmed in 25°C ambient temperature testing.
Exceptional Efficiency
This 80 Plus Gold certified unit can achieve Titanium level efficiency at light loads in a 115V test.
Optimized Thermal Performance
An anodic-coated heat sink keeps average temperatures 5℃ lower than a traditional heat sink for enhanced durability and a prolonged life span.*All performance stats confirmed in 25°C ambient temperature testing.
Fully Modular Cabling
Modular cabling reduces clutter, increases airflow, and improves overall thermal performance.
Zero-RPM Mode
This unit includes a smart thermal control mode that defaults to zero spin.

GX III Gold 1250 ATX 3.1 White Edition
Cooler Master presents the GX Ill Gold featuring exceptional efficiency, low noise output, and superb reliability.
The innovative design streamlines the overall aesthetic of the unit and greatly improves airflow.
Includes ATX 3.1 support and a 90-degree 12V-2X6 PCle 5.1 connector featuring higher electrical durability, improved safety, and capable of bringing up to 600W to your GPU.
*All performance stats confirmed in 25°C ambient temperature testing.
This 80 Plus Gold certified unit can achieve Titanium level efficiency at light loads in a 115V test.
An anodic-coated heat sink keeps average temperatures 5℃ lower than a traditional heat sink for enhanced durability and a prolonged life span.
*All performance stats confirmed in 25°C ambient temperature testing.
Modular cabling reduces clutter, increases airflow, and improves overall thermal performance.
This unit includes a smart thermal control mode that defaults to zero spin.
